$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor completion.

state.description: State directory. Default .changeharbor next to this file. Overridden by CHANGEHARBOR_STATE or --state.

github_secret_env.description: Environment variable holding the GitHub webhook secret.

gitlab_secret_env.description: Environment variable holding the GitLab webhook token.

additionalProperties.description: A repository reviewd serves, keyed by a short lowercase name.

url.description: Web URL of the repository, e.g. https://gitlab.com/group/app. Provider, web and API bases and path are derived from it.

provider.description: github or gitlab. Required only for self-managed hosts.

api_url.description: API base override, e.g. for a GitLab installed under a path prefix.

token_env.description: Environment variable holding the forge token.

token_scheme.description: GitLab only. How the token is sent. Default private-token.

bot_user_id.description: Numeric user ID the token acts as. Resolved from /user when omitted; set it for GitHub App tokens.

fork_source.description: Path of the one fork whose merge requests are accepted, e.g. contributors/app. Resolved to an ID in the lock.

mirror.description: Local git mirror reviewd reads source from.

path.description: Mirror directory. Relative paths resolve against this file.

sync.description: auto (fetch from origin when configured), none, or a configured remote name. Default auto.

branch.description: Target branch. Default: the repository's default branch, pinned in the lock.

model.description: Name of a model in models. Default: default, when defined.

response.description: Offline model response fixture (testing). Mutually exclusive with model.

publish.description: What reviewd may write to the forge.

approvals.description: off, shadow (evaluate everything, write nothing) or submit. Default shadow.

comments.description: off, shadow (render only) or post. Default shadow.

protections.description: required (default): approve only when the forge's own protections are in place. advisory: approve regardless of protection settings; doctor reports gaps as warnings. Must be set explicitly.

inline_comments.description: off, shadow (plan only, no remote calls) or post (one comment per anchored finding on its changed line; findings no longer reported are marked possibly outdated). Default shadow.

suggestions.description: include (default): add a committable suggestion block to inline comments when the model proposes a replacement for changed lines. off: never include one.

inline_min_severity.description: Lowest finding severity posted as an inline comment. Default low: info findings stay in the summary only.

ci_trust.description: How the head pipeline's definition is trusted. Default external_config.

ci_paths.description: With unchanged_config: globs of files that define job behaviour.

required_jobs.description: Job names that must succeed. Default: the policy's required_checks.

required_checks.description: Check name to trusted GitHub App ID.

model.description: Name of a model in models.

review.description: Trusted review guidance and path filters. Comes only from this file, never from the repository under review. Changing it invalidates existing reviews.

instructions.description: Repository-wide review instructions added to every review prompt.

path_instructions.description: Instructions added only when a changed file (old or new path) matches one of the globs.

paths.description: Globs: * within a segment, ? one character, ** whole segments.

exclude.description: Globs of files left out of the model's input (generated, vendored, lockfiles). Risk-policy minimums still count them.
